_howto: Shared contest classification rules (server/src/contests.js), tried in order after an adapter's own `contestRules` (config/sources/<id>.json) and after the built-in U.S. Senate / U.S. House / Governor / measure rules. Each rule: match = a case-insensitive regex tested against the contest name (lower-cased, whitespace collapsed, 'U.S.'/'United States' folded to 'us'); level = federal | statewide | legislative | county | local | judicial | measure; office = a normalized office key; optional kind = partisan | nonpartisan | yes_no | retention (default: worked out from the candidates). A contest no rule matches is stored as level/office 'unclassified', logged and recorded in the `unmatched` table: never dropped. Order matters: county/local words are checked before the bare statewide titles so 'County Treasurer' never becomes the State Treasurer.
